### Fixed
- **The `add-cache-init` pod mutation is idempotent under Kyverno webhook reinvocation** (giantswarm/agent-platform#514; proof 1 of giantswarm/giantswarm#37639). The connectivity chart's `model-serving` pods policy added `hf-cache-init` with a JSON patch (`add /spec/initContainers/0`) and no guard against being applied twice. Kyverno's pod mutation webhook is registered with `reinvocationPolicy: IfNeeded`, and the API server reinvokes it whenever another mutating webhook changed the pod after Kyverno ran — the case for every `LLMInferenceService` workload pod on a Giant Swarm cluster — so the rule inserted the container a second time and the pod was refused by validation: on gazelle (4.28.11) the ReplicaSet of the served preset failed nine times in a row with `spec.initContainers[2].name: Duplicate value: "hf-cache-init"` while the GPU node ran empty (the two `redirect-model-storage-*` rules, strategic merges, were idempotent; before #506 the rule never reached these pods). `add-cache-init` is now a **strategic merge keyed by the container's name**: the container is added the first time and found on a reinvocation, and Kyverno's strategic merge leads a list with the entries it patched, so `hf-cache-init` stays ahead of the `storage-initializer` the way the insert at index 0 put it — the rule stays last in the policy, since a later merge on the storage-initializer would move that one ahead again. Audit of the chart's other mutation rules: `agent-sandbox-pod-security`'s `add-controller-security-context` merges by `(name)` and `+(securityContext)` anchors, and no rule of either chart appends to a list with a JSON patch; nothing else to change. `make verify-model-serving-policies` now applies the rendered policy to its own output for both pod shapes and asserts a no-op (one `hf-cache-init`, one `hf-cache` volume) — the check failed on the previous rule with exactly the duplicate seen on gazelle. The live half — the workload pod admitted on the first ReplicaSet attempt with `hf-cache-init`, the `hf-cache` mount and the 4Gi initializer limit — is the proof's.
